items.headline: Non-Executive Director (part-time) — SBS Board / Special Broadcasting Service Corporation (Sydney)
items.summary: Part-time federal statutory board seat on the SBS Corporation board for a term of up to five years, ~$67,500 p.a., with at least six full-day board meetings a year plus optional Audit & Risk / other committee service; managed by Omera Partners with applications closing 9am AEST on 6 August 2026.
items.so_what: A high-calibre statutory directorship squarely in your FAICD governance wheelhouse, with an Audit & Risk committee pathway that suits your risk/finance background; the close is tomorrow morning, so lodge the online application and resume today.
items.source: Australian Government (Dept of Infrastructure) / Omera Partners

items.headline: Non-Executive Directors / Treasurer — SDECC (Sydney Drug Education & Counselling Centre) (Northern Sydney)
items.summary: Skills-based NFP board recruiting a treasurer with a finance/accounting/business background plus additional non-executive directors; roughly six to seven board meetings a year around Manly/St Leonards.
items.so_what: The treasurer seat is a clean fit for your accounting credential and existing board experience, with a light meeting load close to home — worth a prompt expression of interest.

items.headline: Board Director / Treasurer — The Loop Australia (Sydney, voluntary)
items.summary: National volunteer-run charity seeking a treasurer to join its non-executive board.
items.so_what: A straightforward way to add a current directorship; the treasurer remit maps directly to your FCPA background, though the org is smaller-scale.

items.headline: Board Members — Non-Executive / Treasurer — Guthrie House (Sydney, voluntary)
items.summary: Women's community-services NFP recruiting a treasurer and/or additional non-executive board members.
items.so_what: Finance-skilled directors are explicitly sought — a credible NFP board seat within reach; register interest if the mission appeals.

items.headline: Non-Executive Director / Treasurer — ADSSI Limited (Central Coast & Northern Sydney)
items.summary: Community aged and disability care not-for-profit seeking a financially literate director to fill a retiring director/treasurer seat.
items.so_what: Direct match to your FCPA/FAICD profile — an explicit finance/treasurer skills gap on an established NFP board within commuting reach; register interest promptly.

items.headline: Non-Executive Director — Integricare (Sydney)
items.summary: Children's and family services NFP inviting applications to join its board as a non-executive director.
items.so_what: A general board seat rather than a stated finance gap; situational awareness — worth a look if the sector interests you, but not an obvious skills-match trigger.

items.headline: Chief Financial Officer — Cancer Council NSW (Sydney)
items.summary: Executive finance lead for one of the state's largest health NFPs, owning financial strategy, reporting and controls across a complex, purpose-led organisation.
items.so_what: A genuine C-suite finance seat in the NFP/health sector that fits your FCPA profile and sector affinities; strong role but a competitive executive search — worth a considered application.

items.headline: Senior Manager — Risk — SBS / Special Broadcasting Service (North Shore / Sydney)
items.summary: Owns and continuously improves SBS's enterprise risk management framework, policies and corporate risk register, partnering with leaders across the business to identify, assess and manage strategic and operational risks.
items.so_what: A core senior-manager target on the money for your enterprise-risk and governance strengths, in Sydney; a direct, actionable match — apply promptly and treat it as a lead to verify on SBS Careers.

items.headline: Senior Operational Risk Manager (Line 2) — recruiter-held, markets business (Sydney)
items.summary: Second-line senior operational risk role with a leading markets business unit, ~$180,000-200,000, held by risk-and-compliance specialist Bluefin Resources.
items.so_what: Strong function fit for your risk background and held by a specialist who fills fast; contact Bluefin to confirm it is live and whether it is perm or day-rate, then move quickly.

items.headline: Treasurer — machinery & worktools business, Sydney CBD (Robert Half)
items.summary: Senior corporate-treasury role owning cash-flow management, liquidity planning, banking relationships, debt/funding and financial-risk oversight for an industrial products business; ~$195,000-220,000.
items.so_what: A senior finance seat blending treasury and financial-risk oversight that suits your FCPA background; permanent Sydney CBD, recruiter-held — worth a conversation with Robert Half.

items.headline: Financial Planning & Analysis Manager — water/utilities business, Sydney CBD (Robert Half)
items.summary: Leads budgeting, forecasting, reporting and long-range planning for a Sydney water utility, partnering with senior leaders on commercial insight; ~$136,000-142,000.
items.so_what: Sector boost — essential-services/utilities aligns with your energy/utilities strength; an FP&A leadership seat, though titled Manager, so a solid rather than top-tier match.

items.headline: Finance Business Partnering Manager — ASX-listed, energy/infrastructure exposure (Sydney, hybrid)
items.summary: Leadership business-partnering role across a large, complex ASX-listed division, owning budgeting/forecasting and leading a team of four; ~$220,000-240,000 + super + bonus, two days in office.
items.so_what: Senior, well-paid and with energy/infrastructure exposure that maps to your sector strengths and people-leadership growth; a strong commercial-finance match worth pursuing via Robert Half.

items.headline: Head of FP&A — high-growth FMCG business (Sydney, Sharp & Carter)
items.summary: Newly surfaced Head of FP&A seat with a fast-growing FMCG business, leading forecasting, reporting and commercial analysis.
items.so_what: A genuine 'Head of' finance role and freshly listed; FMCG sits outside your core sectors, so situational awareness — worth a look if you want to broaden, verify it is live on Sharp & Carter.
